product_family: Tenable One Exposure Management Platform with Tenable Hexa AI (agentic AI engine for vulnerability and exposure management). Available in Foundation (asset discovery, vulnerability management, cloud workload protection) and Advanced (risk-based prioritization, attack path analysis) tiers.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Tenable's ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification covers the ISMS supporting Tenable's legal areas, human resources, information technology, software development, executive leadership, and customer support functions.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Completed third-party audit assessing Service Organization Controls compliance. Provided upon request under mutual NDA; contact account representative.

certifications.name: FedRAMP Authorization to Operate (Moderate)
certifications.proof_quote: Tenable One Vulnerability Management and Tenable One Web App Scanning received FedRAMP Authorization to Operate (ATO) in 2021. Tenable One Exposure Management Platform achieved FedRAMP authorization at Moderate impact level in April 2025.

certifications.name: StateRAMP Authorization
certifications.proof_quote: Tenable One Vulnerability Management is StateRAMP authorized, meeting strict cybersecurity standards required by state and local government agencies.

certifications.name: Data Privacy Framework (DPF) Certified
certifications.proof_quote: Tenable certifies compliance with EU-U.S., Swiss-U.S., and UK DPF frameworks, ensuring adequate protection through standard contractual clauses for the transfer of data. Subject to regulatory enforcement powers of U.S. Federal Trade Commission.

certifications.name: Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) STAR Member
certifications.proof_quote: Tenable maintains membership in CSA STAR program for security assurance in the cloud.

certifications.name: NIAP (National Information Assurance Program) Certified
certifications.proof_quote: Certified products: Tenable Security Center, Nessus Manager, Nessus Network Monitor, Nessus Agent. Available at NIAP-CCEVS official product list.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance Posture
certifications.proof_quote: Data Protection Addendum (DPA) applies for customers storing personal data in Tenable Vulnerability Management. Tenable acts as Data Processor; customers are Data Controller. All sub-processors required to be GDPR compliant.

certifications.name: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Tenable holding HIPAA BAA certification. Tenable provides HIPAA compliance audit tools and dashboards to help healthcare organizations achieve HIPAA compliance, but is not documented as a HIPAA-covered entity or BAA signatory.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud-Specific Information Security)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. ISO 27001:2022 is the documented certification; no mention of cloud-specific 27017 extension.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (PII Protection in Cloud)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found in trust documentation or compliance pages.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance & Risk Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Tenable does mention an internal 'AI Governance Council' that approves generative AI applications, but no ISO 42001 certification documented.

privacy.ai_training_note: Tenable explicitly states: 'No identifiable customer data is used in training any model, including Large Language Models.' Approved third-party AI providers are contractually prohibited from retaining or using customer data for model training. Tenable employs an internal AI Governance Council to approve all generative AI applications.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region (AWS): AMER, APAC, EMEA. EU-US, Swiss-US, and UK Data Privacy Framework certified for international transfers. Customers can specify regional provisioning at purchase.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Standard TLS/SSL encryption for data in transit; AWS data center encryption for cloud platform

security.name: Data Retention Policy
security.value: Customer scan data retained for 15 months; PCI-related data minimum 36 months (per PCI DSS retention rules)

security.name: Vulnerability Disclosure Program
security.value: HackerOne responsible disclosure program; Security advisories published on Tenable security page

security.name: Service Status Monitoring
security.value: Real-time status page at status.tenable.com; incident response aligned with customer SLAs

security.name: Accessibility & Compliance
security.value: Section 508 voluntary product accessibility compliance documented

products.name: Tenable One Foundation
products.data_scope: Asset discovery, vulnerability scanning, cloud workload protection, AI discovery
products.notes: Includes AI Discovery feature to identify AI assets and exposures. Tenable Hexa AI available in Foundation tier (as of May 20, 2026).

products.name: Tenable One Advanced
products.data_scope: Risk-based prioritization, attack path analysis, AI workload protection, cloud security posture management, exposure orchestration
products.notes: Tenable Hexa AI included. Adds business context and attack path analysis to Foundation capabilities.

products.name: Tenable Hexa AI
products.data_scope: Automated exposure intelligence, multi-step workflow orchestration, human-in-the-loop approvals
products.notes: Agentic AI for exposure management. Powered by Tenable's Exposure Data Fabric. Available in Foundation and Advanced; generally available as of May 20, 2026. Does not train on customer data.

compare.pricing_model: Ratio-based licensing with progressive pricing (volume discounts). Foundation vs. Advanced tiered. 'Count once' principle: single asset charged once regardless of sensors deployed.
compare.data_residency: Cloud-only (AWS). Multi-region options: AMER, APAC, EMEA. Regional provisioning chosen at purchase time.

flags: SOC 2 Type II report is not publicly available; requires NDA and account representative request. Audit was completed but full control documentation restricted.

HIPAA BAA not documented—Tenable provides HIPAA compliance tooling (audit dashboards, scanning frameworks) but is not itself HIPAA-certified as a covered entity. Healthcare customers requiring BAA should confirm BAA availability directly.
CSA STAR specific level (Gold/Silver/Bronze) not publicly disclosed. Documentation confirms membership but not assessment level.
ISO 27017 (cloud-specific) and ISO 27018 (PII in cloud) certifications not documented. Tenable's primary cloud certification is ISO 27001:2022 plus FedRAMP/StateRAMP.

AI-governance certification (ISO/IEC 42001) not held, though Tenable employs an internal AI Governance Council for generative AI approval. This is a governance practice, not a third-party certification.
